title: Column product catalogue
description: A purple mono eyebrow over a hairline, a heavy 48px navy two-line heading, then product groups: a short group label on the left and a two-column grid of soft grey 56px tiles on the right, each with a small white icon square in the group's accent colour. The tiles rise, scale up from 95% and fade in, one after another, as they scroll into view.
notes: each group takes a tone for its icons (chart-1…5, highlight, primary)
the tile reveal is a CSS view timeline; without support or with reduced motion the tiles simply show
